correctness.rationale: Taking adjacent differences modulo 3 gives signs ±1; abab corresponds to an alternating triple, so comparison bits avoid consecutive ones. The six initial letter/sign choices give 6 F_n admissible words. At an interior substitution the neighbors must coincide; swapping the local sign pair (s,-s) to (-s,s) then creates an alternating triple with the next unchanged sign, or with the previous one at the last interior position. Such an unchanged sign exists for n>=4. Thus all moves are at endpoints. For n>=5 the two endpoint restrictions are independent: each has two choices on an equal-sign pair in the core and one choice on an unequal-sign pair. For k=n-4>=2 core comparison bits, the counts with endpoint types 00, exactly one 1, and 11 are F_k, 2 F_(k-1), F_(k-2), obtained by fixing endpoints and their forced zero neighbors; at k=2 the counts are 1,2,0, and at k=3 the 11 case is just 101. Each core contributes a connected K_1, K_2 or C_4, with six initial choices per bit string. At n=5 there is one comparison bit, and at n=4 the forbidden word removes one vertex from each endpoint square. The independence polynomials multiply; their degrees and leading coefficients give the asserted sizes and counts. Dividing by 6 F_n and taking Fibonacci ratios gives phi^(-6)+2 phi^(-5)+2 phi^(-4)=5-2 sqrt(5). The alphabet, boundary model and detection-only reading are essential.
residual_risks: The supplied finite enumeration through n=16 was not rerun and is not the basis of the all-length proof.

evidence: Tang et al. allow a substitution as part of a noisy fixed-length tandem duplication; their k=1 statement makes their irreducible family 1ND-detecting for that channel. broader_coverage.reasoning: The graph here compares equal-length admissible inputs at Hamming distance one and imposes no duplication/root operations. Even a correct construction or asymptotic bound for a stronger mixed channel on a narrower source language would not classify all components or count all codebooks here.

checked_sources: Chee et al., arXiv:1801.02310, Definition 2 and Corollary 1
value.rationale: The constrained source language is established in coding theory. The graph's confinement to fibers of the whole interior is a structural restriction not visible from Fibonacci enumeration alone. It identifies the complete set of editing-confusability components, yields the exact optimum for one-substitution detection, and gives the total number of codebooks at every size and a nontrivial limiting occupied fraction.
residual_risks: The limiting fraction is an optimal density within this language; the result does not give substitution correction or a capacity theorem for a mixed duplication/edit channel.
